en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a general view of the village of Rochefort-Montagne in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are clustered stone houses with tiled roofs and a prominent church with a square bell tower. The village is surrounded by fields, trees, and hills in the background. Text is printed at the top and bottom margins in French, giving the title and publisher information.
